name: @aws-sdk/client-cloudwatch
description: AWS SDK for JavaScript Cloudwatch Client for Node.js, Browser and React Native

readme.summary: The README provides a solid overview of the AWS SDK v3 but lacks specific guidance for the CloudWatch client, which may confuse users seeking detailed instructions.
